features.label: Sixty duels, undefeated
features.detail: Then wrote the book at the end of his life, in a cave, dying. The theory comes after the practice, never before.

features.label: Won by breaking etiquette
features.detail: Showed up hours late, fought with a wooden oar, unsettled opponents before contact. Strategy over honour.

features.label: Barely about swords
features.detail: The Book of Five Rings is mostly carpentry, rhythm, and how to see. The fighting is the smallest part.
